parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing risk is severe and state-driven: immigration law is documented as used to deport queer/trans travellers without upheld charges; vague morality/sex-work provisions, judicially expanded to remove any financial-exchange requirement, are routinely used for arrests with prison sentences. Police entrapment on dating apps specifically targets transgender women, with blackmail, arrests, physical abuse in custody and coerced anal examinations, plus official incitement after 2017. There is no anti-discrimination recourse and healthcare discrimination is pervasive. Absence of a later dated forced-examination case is not evidence of cessation, especially with rising arrests reported in 2023 and routine use described in 2026. No execution regime is documented, keeping it above 0.05-0.15, but organised targeting with imprisonment and custody abuse places it in High Risk.
